purpose: Fixed-model fixed-training-budget developmental data intervention, not final test or closed-loop success

training.new_slot_rule: Among slots seen exactly21 times and never in a partial16 batch of the historical seed11 schedule, sort by sha256('p4-data-v1-slot:'+decimal_slot), choose first384, then sort chosen slot IDs; map family rank then window start
training.checkpoint_selection: final1000 only; no early stopping, lambda search, seed selection or normalizer refit

collection.initial_rng: numpy PCG64(SeedSequence([split_initial_seed, family_rank])); draw object_x, object_y, object_yaw, gap, eccentric_abs_offset in that order, including unused draws
collection.family_rank_rule: geometry=rank%3; within_geometry_rank=rank//3; Y pair index=within_geometry_rank%2; X index=within_geometry_rank%3; eccentric sign positive on even within_geometry_rank
collection.reset_pusher_rule: rotate body-frame anchor then translate by object_xy; subtract0.2*world_command; use actual settling and warmup, never assign velocity
collection.family_split: register family IDs before physics; all four variants and every warmup/repeat stay in the same family split

evaluation.unit: 12 held-out development families, each with four related physical trajectories; one model seed
evaluation.Y_primary: On Y1 evaluation heads, family mean teacher-conditioned object and pusher XY errors over core steps1..5; average S variants once because their heads are identical
evaluation.S_primary: On S1 evaluation trajectories, start at actual core state10 and freely predict five zero actions; object and pusher XY endpoint errors, equal weight Y0/Y1 within family
evaluation.interaction: D11-D10-D01+D00; report each primary endpoint, do not pool units

bootstrap.purpose: descriptive fixed-model uncertainty, not final-test inference

evaluation.directional_support_rule: Both corresponding contrasts have bootstrap upper bound below0 for both preregistered XY endpoints; otherwise mixed/inconclusive; always report all12 family differences
regression: original validation K1/K5/K10 with regime and failure denominators
